name: omninode
description: Save and read Omninode Sessions and Skills from Claude Code or Codex, and ask the other agent a question through the local Omninode Bridge with a live view.

interface.shortDescription: Save and read Omninode sessions and skills
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to your Omninode account to save and read Sessions, save and install Skills, and ask Claude Code a question through the local Bridge. Uploads go directly to storage with a single curl; session and skill contents never pass through the model.
defaultPrompt: Save this whole session to Omninode.
Upload my local Skill to Omninode.
Ask Claude Code through the Omninode Bridge.
